name: Encode-Scene
definition: A method to train a scene representation in a 3D-aware latent space by encoding input images into latent space first, then training the NeRF (Tri-Planes) to fit these latent images.
summary: Encode-Scene trains 3D-aware latent scene representations by caching pre-computed image encodings, avoiding decoder differentiation to significantly accelerate optimization compared to Decode-Scene.
